title: Certify κ = 0.0030266747680744 and a smaller matched compiler using direct tails
body:
This certifies **conditional κ = 0.0030266747680744**, a tiny increase of **3.0744 × 10⁻¹²** over #5387, on the unchanged eight-relation paid/target profile. The more substantial companion result is a smaller compiler at #5387’s unchanged κ: tensor power **1024 → 505**, logarithmic power **1000 → 484**, and the sufficient exponent H in N = 2^H falls from 409,549,000,000,000,000 to **194,586,000,000,000,000**, a factor of about **2.105**. This is not a measured runtime speedup.

Use the existing fully charged higher-moment theorem directly: `α^v + 2γ^v + 2δ^v ≤ 1/(1+vρ) + 2g^v + 2d^v`. The predecessor replaced both tails by a coarse `4/2^32` allowance. With exact envelopes g=957/1000 and d=952/1000, a reusable rational selector chooses the least tensor power satisfying the sufficient bound, then the least admissible positive logarithmic power and a finite integer threshold. README.md proves sufficiency and termination; the underlying tail theorem and logarithmic majorant retain zxv’s credit.

At the new endpoint, tested saving is 0.0030266747680745, reserve 10⁻¹⁷, tensor power 757, logarithmic power 725, and outer gap 1/70,000,000,000,000,000. The exact fixed-profile root lies in `(0.0030266747680745498, 0.0030266747680745499)`. The compiler threshold is `N=2^3634890000000000000000`, with all 54 strict and four functional outer predicates positive. This much higher threshold funds the smaller gap: the higher-κ result and the smaller matched compiler are distinct parameter choices.

The 64,148-paid / 10,800-target invoice and all native operations are unchanged. All surrendered helper outputs, eight simultaneous snapshots, scalar work, routes and completion costs remain charged. Frozen #5387 native code/word/receipts are retained byte-for-byte and authenticated; no pending Git object is required at runtime. The package freshly replays both native directions and source identities, the p16 controller and complete bill, two rational interval engines, direct tails, compiler capacity and outer predicates. No expanded product/compiler word is materialized.

Validation: registered normal and optimized Python 3.12 standard-library checks; all native and outer controls; rejection of invalid/inexact parameter inputs; preceding-power failures; coarse-tail failure; separate integer cross-product checks of v=757 and v=505; committed-byte checks; official export integrity and read-only optimized Git-free replay. All checks are author/AI checks. No hosted CI, independent human or Lean/kernel acceptance is claimed. Full-history ancestry checking is not claimed in the shallow checkout.
